Nina (CS): Quick check-in for HeliosHealth private/VPC onboarding. They pushed timeline to week 2. Current blockers: outbound TLS to their SIEM, KMS grant for redwood deploy role, CloudTrail delivery retention, and the IAM role mapping for log write. Can folks share status?

Omar (Network): Working through the egress design. Plan is to use a managed NAT GW with stable SNAT IPs. I'll post the IP set + minimal firewall rule example by EOD. If their VPC has an egress proxy we’ll need explicit bypass for our collector FQDNs.

Omar (Network): Quick ask for Helios: please run `curl -v https://siem.helioshealth.local/health` from a pod and paste the logs so we can confirm TLS and SNI reachability.

Celeste (Security): On KMS: we reviewed their requested key ARN. Need them to add a key policy statement allowing `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/helios-redwood-deploy` with actions `kms:Encrypt`,`kms:Decrypt`,`kms:GenerateDataKey*`. Also recommend scoping via `kms:ViaService` and an `aws:SourceAccount` condition. I'll attach a short policy snippet and a rotation checklist.

Celeste (Security): Policy example (customer editable):
```
{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodDeploy","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/helios-redwood-deploy"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```

Celeste (Security): One question for Nina: did Helios indicate whether they require HSM-backed CMKs? If yes we should start provisioning a custom key store now.

Javi (SRE): Logs: two options supported — S3 (recommended for retention and export) or TLS syslog push to their SIEM. For S3 we need a bucket name + a bucket policy granting `PutObject`/`PutObjectAcl` to our writer principal, or they can create an `AssumeRole` for us. For TLS we need their collector IPs, port, and cert fingerprint.

Javi (SRE): I can spin up a temporary TLS endpoint in staging for a smoke test. Will need an IAM role ARN if they want S3 testing.

Nina (CS): Risk note: Helios flagged a compliance cutover window in 12 business days. If we don't validate KMS + egress by then they will evaluate delaying launch. Please prioritize SNAT IPs and KMS policy.

Omar (Network): Affirmative — SNAT IP list and short runbook by EOD. Will include a troubleshooting checklist for proxy/pods that can't reach external hosts.

Celeste (Security): I'll post the full KMS key policy sample and a two-page KMS rotation/HSM checklist by EOD. Will include example IAM trust policy for deploy role and minimal KMS actions.

Javi (SRE): I'll have the staging collector endpoint + TLS fingerprint ready tomorrow morning and the assume-role JSON for S3 ingestion.

Nina (CS): Action items summary: 
- Omar: publish SNAT IPs + runbook (EOD)
- Celeste: publish KMS policy + rotation/HSM checklist (EOD)
- Javi: provision staging collector + IAM assume-role spec (tomorrow AM)
- Nina: confirm HSM preference with Helios and schedule an enablement call if they want HSM (today)

Nina (CS): I'll draft a concise customer email with the attached runbook/policies and book a 48hr follow-up. Please drop links here when available.

ops-bot: FYI: scheduled maintenance window for redwood-staging-collector on 2024-10-03T02:00:00Z — expect brief restart.

Nina (CS): Thanks team — ping me @nina if you want me on any calls.
